title: VS tests fail occasionally during network creation
author: daall
body:

**Description**
Very occasionally when running the PR tests or canary tests in sonic-swss, sonic-sairedis, or sonic-utilities we get a setup error like so:

```
RuntimeError: Failed to run command: ip link add xenodochial_ type veth peer name eth2. rc=2. output: RTNETLINK answers: File exists
```

This happens while `pytest` is initializing the network for the virtual switch to connect to the server container.

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run a set of docker virtual switch tests on Jenkins
2. Wait for `ip link` runtime error

**Describe the results you received:**
Network setup fails because the links exist in the host namespace already.

**Describe the results you expected:**
The network setup should not fail. The container names and namespaces should be unique, and should be cleaned up after the tests are over, so there **should** be no conflict here.

linkedPullRequests.title: [dvs] Fix issue where concurrent netns operations cause test setup to fail
linkedPullRequests.author: daall
linkedPullRequests.body:
Signed-off-by: Danny Allen <daall@microsoft.com>

Please also provide the following information in this pull request:

**What I did**
I moved some of the dynamic test setup steps to run inside the network namespace. This needs to be done b/c we may have multiple test runs ongoing at the same time on Jenkins, and if two tests re-use a name such as "eth9" before the link has been added to the namespace then it will cause the tests to crash and fail.

**Why I did it**
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/5205

**How I verified it**
Ran tests locally with `sudo pytest -sv` and they passed.
